affected_subject.reason: Comparison functions (eq, lt) of the packedFloat library are identified as the affected component.

trigger_or_action.reason: Calling comparison functions on unnormalized packedFloat inputs (e.g., 100e5 vs 1e7) triggers the issue.

direct_effect.reason: lt incorrectly returns true for mathematically equal/greater values, causing wrong comparison results and wrongful liquidation.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected mathematical ordering (1000 > 10, no liquidation) vs actual raw-exponent comparison yielding lt=true establishes the violated relation.

summary: Report identifies packedFloat comparison functions, unnormalized input trigger, incorrect comparison/liquidation effect, and the expected-vs-actual mathematical ordering violation.
